clue.text: Show signs of wearying having got on bottle

parts.note: to flag is to tire or droop, showing signs of weariness

explanation.surface: Someone tiring visibly after reaching for the bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagon is a large bottle or vessel for wine or cider.

clue.text: Divine quarters for the crew the French finally abandoned

indicators.note: finally abandoned means the French article is dropped from the end

parts.note: the forecastle is the crew's quarters in the bow of a ship
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Crew quarters given up by the French at last.
explanation.definitionFit: To divine is to foresee or predict, which is what a forecast does.

clue.text: Charge alas false — initially confident copper taken in

indicators.note: taken in means the next pieces go inside the rearranged letters
false signals the letters of alas are not in their true order
initially means the first letter of confident is used

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A false accusation against a confident policeman who's been arrested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false' rearranges the letters to ASAL, and 'taken in' places the confident initial plus copper after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An accusal is an accusation, a charge laid against someone.

clue.text: Public institution with new depiction of pagan hero

indicators.note: a new depiction means the letters of pagan hero are redrawn

explanation.surface: A public body with a fresh portrayal of a heathen hero.
explanation.definitionFit: An orphanage is an institution that houses and cares for orphaned children.

clue.text: Rushes around company and curses

indicators.note: around tells us one piece encloses the other, the rushes wrapping the company

parts.note: surges means rushes forward

explanation.surface: A crowd surges round a firm while swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Scourges are afflictions or banes, and curses in the noun sense are the same kind of torment.

clue.text: Where to get advice from diplomat with money, man making big promise

parts.note: a consul is a diplomatic official
tin is British slang for money
a groom makes wedding vows

explanation.surface: Seeking counsel from a diplomat with cash and a man about to wed.
explanation.definitionFit: A consulting room is where a doctor or specialist sees patients and gives advice.

clue.text: Amercan period in a manner of speaking

parts.note: US stands for American; the clue as held misspells the word
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: An American era in a manner of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is the customary way words are used, a manner of speaking.

clue.text: Maiden brought to life by drink after festival

indicators.note: after means the drink comes after the festival

parts.note: a gala is a festive occasion
tea is a drink

explanation.surface: A girl revived by a cuppa after a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Galatea is the statue in Greek myth that Aphrodite brought to life for Pygmalion.

clue.text: Spotting pony with leg hidden in grass

indicators.note: in places the reduced pony inside the word for grass

parts.note: to grass is to inform on someone, and so is to sing

indicators.note: hidden here means the leg word is put out of sight, removed from the pony

parts.note: taken as written
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: Seeing a pony with one leg concealed in the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' is not turf but the verb to inform; 'hidden' removes the leg from the pony, leaving PY. In cricket the on side is also called the leg side.
explanation.definitionFit: Spying is watching secretly or catching sight of, so spotting.

clue.text: With Director on top, is job a let-down?

indicators.note: on top means the director's letter sits above the rest in this down entry

parts.note: an appointment is a job or post

explanation.surface: With the boss in charge, is the job disappointing?
explanation.definitionFit: A disappointment is something that fails expectations, a let-down.

clue.text: This party is cheating with new leader

indicators.note: a new leader means the first letter of the word for cheating is swapped for another

parts.note: deception is cheating or trickery

explanation.surface: A political party accused of cheating gets a new boss.
explanation.walkthrough: The new first letter R is not clued separately; the answer and the definition fix it.
explanation.definitionFit: A reception is a formal party, such as one after a wedding.

clue.text: Friend hiding love shows steel?

indicators.note: hiding means the friend's word conceals another inside it

parts.note: an ally is a friend
love is zero in tennis, giving the letter O

explanation.surface: A friend concealing affection reveals inner toughness.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags steel as an example: steel is one alloy, so the definition works by instance. 'shows steel' is a phrase about grit in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel is an alloy of iron and carbon, so an example stands in for the class.

clue.text: Bark when vehicle ploughs into Spanish house

indicators.note: ploughs into means the vehicle goes inside the house

parts.note: casa is Spanish for house
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A dog barks as a car crashes into a Spanish villa.
explanation.definitionFit: Cascara is the dried bark of a buckthorn, used as a laxative.

clue.text: Superior groom not taken in

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for upper-class or superior
to groom is to tidy or neaten

explanation.surface: A posh groom refuses to be fooled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not taken in' reads as 'not fooled' but means not eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Food left uneaten has not been taken in or consumed.

clue.text: Dance rehearsal sadly seeing several drop out

indicators.note: several letters dropping out at each end leaves a run inside the words

explanation.surface: A dance rehearsal goes badly as several performers quit.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American dance.

clue.text: Father goes round all twisted — it's to do with a kneecap

definitions.text: it's to do with a kneecap

indicators.note: goes round means the father word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: pater is Latin, and old schoolboy slang, for father

indicators.note: twisted means the word all is rearranged

explanation.surface: Dad wraps himself round everything, all bent out of shape at the knee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted' turns the word into LLA, and 'goes round' has the father wrap it, after his fourth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Patellar is the adjective from patella, the medical name of the kneecap.

clue.text: Fibs about France's No.1 politician in biography

indicators.note: about means the fibs surround the next letter

parts.note: fibs are lies

indicators.note: No.1 means the first letter of France

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: Lies about France's leading politician appear in a biography.
explanation.definitionFit: A life story is an account of someone's life, a biography.

clue.text: Move on, having dropped in Liberal Club

indicators.note: having dropped in means the Liberal letter falls inside the rest

parts.note: to budge is to move

explanation.surface: Being told to move on after visiting the Liberal Club.
explanation.definitionFit: A bludgeon is a heavy club used as a weapon.

clue.text: Gushing wateriness — all as a result of these?

definitions.text: Gushing wateriness — all as a result of these?

indicators.note: gushing suggests letters spilling out in a new order

explanation.surface: All this watery flow comes from these sources.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and is the wordplay at once: such wells gush naturally under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Artesian wells tap water under pressure so that it rises or gushes without pumping.

clue.text: Two back parts of store should have beans etc — check

indicators.note: two back parts means the final two letters of store

parts.note: pulses are edible seeds such as beans and lentils

explanation.surface: Two back sections of a shop should stock beans and so on, check.
explanation.definitionFit: To repulse an attack is to check or drive it back.

clue.text: Wild time in Florida

indicators.note: in places the time inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: FL is the postal abbreviation for Florida
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Having a wild time in Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: Feral describes animals that have become wild after domestication.

clue.text: Polish church leader denied work? Nonsense!

parts.note: to rub is to polish

indicators.note: denied means the church leader is refused the work, which is taken away

parts.note: a bishop leads a church diocese
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A Polish cleric refused a job? Rubbish!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality but is the verb to polish.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish is nonsense, as in talking rubbish.

clue.text: Hood being worn in middle of lesson will bring dirty looks

indicators.note: being worn in means the hood goes inside, like a garment on
middle of takes the central letters of lesson

parts.note: a cowl is a monk's hood

explanation.surface: Wearing a hood during a lesson will earn glares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' takes the central pair of a six-letter word, and 'being worn in' puts the hood between them like clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Scowls are angry frowns, the dirty looks someone gives.

clue.text: Policeman leading one group — assistant taking control?

indicators.note: leading means the policeman comes before the rest

parts.note: cop is slang for a policeman
one is the Roman numeral I
a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: A police officer heading a team acts as deputy in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A co-pilot is a second pilot who assists and may take the controls of an aircraft.

clue.text: Modern device — one not working well, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear means the clue words are taken by sound

parts.note: a lazer would be one who lazes, not working

explanation.surface: Is a new gadget an idler, so it's said?
explanation.definitionFit: A laser is a modern optical device producing a narrow intense beam of light.

clue.text: Bloomer made by girl meeting American friend

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
bud is American slang for a buddy or friend

explanation.surface: A gaffe made when a girl meets her American pal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder but means something that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosebud is a flower about to bloom, so it is a bloomer in the literal sense.

clue.text: See 18
Income so terrible — start to expect to cut back

indicators.note: terrible signals the letters of income so are made a mess of
start to means only the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: With income so bad, expect to cut spending.
explanation.definitionFit: To economise is to cut back on spending or save money.

clue.text: Chemical test — area devastated

indicators.note: devastated means the letters of test and area are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A chemical test leaves an area laid waste.
explanation.definitionFit: A stearate is a salt or ester of stearic acid, a chemical compound.

clue.text: Some biography — phenomenal bit of writing!

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Praise for a remarkable piece of biographical writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hyphen is a small mark used in writing, literally a bit of it.
